name: PersonalLLM
description: PersonalLLM is a public benchmark focused on adapting large language models to individual user preferences. It features open-ended prompts with diverse high-quality answers reflecting heterogeneous latent preferences, providing a testbed for personalization algorithms under data sparsity conditions.
reputation: A new benchmark for personalization research that is promising but not yet broadly established as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Simulates diverse preferences using pre-trained reward models; explores in-context learning and meta-learning baselines.
